normal_client_order: AgentContext.run calls initServerSession then private newClassLoader, then starts AgentRunnerThread. AgentRunner loads server-selected class and invokes declared start(AgentContext).
RemoteAgent.start calls private initApplicationContext. It combines pre-context files and picked startup XMLs in one refresh.
applicationContextRemoteAgentStartup.xml declares AgentRegistrationBean. AgentRegistrationBean registers the native definition and optionally saves returned id/name/description.

applicationContextRemoteAgentStartupCore.xml defines agentMessageListenerConnector depends-on agentRegistrationBean; executableBuildAgent depends-on that connector, init-method=start; heartBeatScheduler depends-on executableBuildAgent, init-method=start.
native_registration_review.registration_only_boundary: Registration and consumer definitions are in separate XML files, and protected context-file selectors exist. However normal native startup loads both; no supported stop-after-registration flag or verified consumer-free launcher was established. Do not claim a custom client impossible, or falsely claim the XMLs are inseparable.

native_client_identity_fixture.scope: Actual native AgentConfiguration and XMLConfiguration, synthetic XML/UUID/id in owned temp only; private fields injected solely to isolate reader/writer. No real home/config identity read; not full startup/protocol proof.

preprovision_review.normal_returning_record_path: Returning visitor gets stored BuildAgent.getDefinition(), updates status/name/capabilities and passes stored definition to savePipeline; no setEnabled call in inspected remote visitor or save visitor. Supports preservation in inspected normal path, not live DB/cache proof.
preprovision_review.missing_record_failure_path: If AgentManager.getAgent(id)==null, visitRemote sets incoming id=-1 and returns. registerAgentInternal then follows registerNewAgent on the same incoming definition (default enabled=true). Thus missing pre-provisioned records do not force a registration failure.
preprovision_review.identity_failure_path: Native cfg reader defaults missing id to -1; saveAgentDefinition catches ConfigurationException, warns and returns rather than vetoing worker startup.
preprovision_review.uuid_binding: Returning visitor checks UUID mismatch only when manual remote-agent authentication is enabled. Existing manual-auth OFF was not changed.
preprovision_review.decision: Do not create server records, seed real identities, install plugins, toggle auth, or start based on this candidate. A consumer-free registration stage or enforced queue-activation gate still needs implementation/validation before live use.
